hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Europe, bordering the Adriatic Sea and Ionian Sea, between Greece to the south and Montenegro and Kosovo to the north || mostly mountains and hills; small plains along coast || strategic location along Strait of Otranto (links Adriatic Sea to Ionian Sea and Mediterranean Sea) || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, coal, bauxite, chromite, copper, iron ore, nickel, salt, timber, hydropower, arable land || Exports: garments, footwear, electricity, crude petroleum, iron alloys (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly mountains and hills; small plains along coast || Southeastern Europe, bordering the Adriatic Sea and Ionian Sea, between Greece to the south and Montenegro and Kosovo to the north

climate.excerpt: mild temperate; cool, cloudy, wet winters; hot, clear, dry summers; interior is cooler and wetter || destructive earthquakes; tsunamis occur along southwestern coast; floods; drought

economy.excerpt: upper-middle-income Balkan economy; EU accession candidate; growth bolstered by tourism, agriculture, mining, construction, and private consumption; fiscal consolidation through revenue collection and tax compliance enhancements to address public debt; challenges include weak governance, corruption, and high emigration rates || Exports: garments, footwear, electricity, crude petroleum, iron alloys (2023) || Industries: food; footwear, apparel and clothing; lumber, oil, cement, chemicals, mining, basic metals, hydropower
